name: Verdant Robotics
description: 农业机器人公司，开发 SharpShooter 精准施药系统，采用 AI 植物和杂草识别技术实现单株级别的农业投入品施用
description_en: Agricultural robotics company developing SharpShooter precision application system using AI-based plant and weed identification for plant-level agricultural input application
why_matters: 与 Sabanto 自主拖拉机技术集成，实现自主田间导航和单株级精准施药的结合，通过 AI 识别技术仅在需要的位置施用农业投入品，显著减少化学品使用
why_matters_en: Integrated with Sabanto's autonomous tractor technology to combine autonomous field navigation with plant-level precision application, using AI identification to apply agricultural inputs only where required, significantly reducing chemical usage
latest_news: 2026年6月与 Sabanto 宣布技术集成，结合自主拖拉机系统和 SharpShooter 精准施药技术，实现自主导航和单株靶向喷洒
latest_news_en: Announced technology integration with Sabanto in June 2026, combining autonomous tractor system with SharpShooter precision application technology for autonomous navigation and plant-level targeted spraying
source_title: Robotics in Agriculture Market (2035): AI-Driven Farm

evidence.quote: Sabanto and Verdant Robotics announced a technology integration in June 2026, combining Sabanto's autonomous tractor operation system with Verdant's SharpShooter precision application technology. The integrated platform enables autonomous field navigation and plant-level spraying, allowing farmers to target individual weeds while reducing unnecessary chemical applications.

name: Farmonaut
description: 农业AI卫星监测平台,通过卫星和无人机图像转换为植被指数、应力图和土壤水分估计,使用深度学习预测分析标记需要关注的区域,支持$4.99-$949.99月费按地块大小分级订阅,覆盖5-1500公顷。
description_en: Agricultural satellite monitoring platform converting satellite and drone imagery into vegetation indices, stress maps, and soil-moisture estimates using deep-learning predictive analytics. Tiered monthly pricing from $4.99 (5 ha) to $949.99 (1,500 ha), checked October 30, 2026.
why_matters: 公开定价的成熟农业AI产品,通过卫星和无人机图像指导精准侦察,避免覆盖整个田地,支持从小农到大规模农场的多级订阅模式,代表可扩展的低成本AI决策支持系统。
why_matters_en: Mature, publicly priced agricultural AI product guiding precision scouting via satellite and drone imagery instead of full-field coverage. Tiered subscription model serves smallholders to large operations. Represents scalable, low-cost decision-support system.
latest_news: 2026年10月30日确认定价指南,提供5个卫星监测等级,从5公顷的$4.99/月到1500公顷的$949.99/月,支持多种分析层级。
latest_news_en: Pricing guide verified October 30, 2026, offering five satellite-monitoring tiers from $4.99/month (5 ha) to $949.99/month (1,500 ha).
source_title: AI in Agriculture: Real Costs, ROI & Case Studies (2026)

evidence.quote: Farmonaut, for example, lists five satellite-monitoring tiers from $4.99 a month for 5 hectares to $949.99 a month for 1,500 hectares on its pricing guide (checked 30 October 2026).

name: Sky Sense
description: 基于无人机的鸟类缓解AI解决方案，用于农业害虫防控
description_en: Drone-based bird mitigation AI solution for agricultural pest control
why_matters: 在Reservoir Farms生态中运行的专业农业物理AI组件，与Bonsai Robotics、Cordon和Rootline Robotics等创新农机整合，扩展到华盛顿州果树和蓝莓种植
why_matters_en: Specialized agricultural physical AI component operating within Reservoir Farms ecosystem, integrating with innovative ag robotics like Bonsai, Cordon, and Rootline to address labor-intensive crop challenges across Washington tree fruit and blueberry production
latest_news: 加入Reservoir Farms华盛顿州Yakima Valley新站点，该站点计划于2027年春季开放，与华盛顿树果研究委员会和北美蓝莓理事会合作
latest_news_en: Joined Reservoir Farms Washington site in Yakima Valley, opening spring 2027, in partnership with Washington Tree Fruit Research Commission and North American Blueberry Council
source_title: Reservoir Farms to open physical AI hub in Washington State

evidence.quote: Sky Sense (drone-based bird mitigation), Cordon (precision spraying), and Rootline Robotics (weeding via electrocution) will join the Washington site as members

name: Evertrue Capital
description: 专注英国和欧洲早期阶段投资的风险投资基金，平均单笔投资约35万英镑，重点关注 AI 和金融科技领域，计划三年内投资至少20家公司
description_en: Early-stage VC fund focused on U.K. and Europe with average check size around £350,000, targeting AI and fintech sectors, planning to back at least 20 companies over three years
why_matters: 由曾投资 Wise、Marshmallow 等独角兽公司的资深投资人 Yvonne Bajela 创立，获得英国商业银行等五家机构支持，专注捕捉英国 AI 热潮中的下一代顶尖人才
why_matters_en: Founded by veteran investor Yvonne Bajela who backed unicorns like Wise and Marshmallow, with backing from five institutions including British Business Bank, focused on capturing next-gen top talent in U.K.'s AI boom
latest_news: 2026年11月宣布完成超额认购的1700万美元首期基金，已投资7家公司，80%的有限合伙人来自英国
latest_news_en: Announced oversubscribed $17M Fund I in November 2026, already backed seven companies, 80% of LPs are U.K.-based
source_title: Yvonne Bajela is bringing $17M in fresh capital to Europe’s startup scene

evidence.quote: she announced that her own fund, Evertrue Capital, officially closed an oversubscribed $17 million Fund I

She spent more than a decade as a VC, most recently at LocalGlobe and Impact X Capital Partners, where she made bets on now-unicorn companies like the fintech Wise, the insurance company Marshmallow, and robotaxi Mooves

name: Odessia
description: AI旅行助手，可在数分钟内根据用户偏好生成可预订的旅行行程。2026年夏季已有数万用户规划价值6000万美元年度旅行。
description_en: AI travel agent that creates bookable travel itineraries adhering to user preferences within minutes. Generated $60 million per year worth of travel planning for tens of thousands of users by summer 2026.
why_matters: 由Sonder联合创始人创办，采用AI原生架构开发。创始人通过AI智能体在2026年完成原需40小时的任务，展现AI agent实际生产力提升。不足一年内融资600万美元后被OpenAI收购。
why_matters_en: Founded by Sonder co-founder with AI-native architecture. Founder demonstrated 20x productivity gains using AI agents (2-hour vs 40-hour tasks). Raised $6M Series A from Sequoia, acquired by OpenAI within one year of founding.
latest_news: 2026年11月被OpenAI收购，创始人Francis Davidson加入OpenAI团队专注旅行未来发展。服务已停止。
latest_news_en: Acquired by OpenAI in November 2026. Founder Francis Davidson joins OpenAI to focus on future of travel. Service discontinued.
source_title: OpenAI acquires Sonder co-founder’s new travel tech company Odessia

evidence.quote: raise a $6-million round led by Sequoia
One of the co-founders behind Montréal-founded, San Francisco-based alternative lodging company Sonder

name: Kognia
description: 提供认知 AI 代理,通过推理而非脚本解决问题,Alan 产品线覆盖客户体验、流程智能和语音文本代理,在医疗领域将行政流程从数月缩短至数周
description_en: Provides cognitive AI agents that reason through problems instead of following scripts, Alan product line covers customer experience, process intelligence, and voice/text agents, cutting healthcare administrative timelines from months to weeks
why_matters: 专注于认知 AI 而非传统脚本式自动化,在电信和医疗领域实现60-95%的流程时间缩减,其推理能力可自主验证合同、审查账单并执行修复
why_matters_en: Focuses on cognitive AI rather than traditional script-based automation, achieving 60-95% process time reduction in telecom and healthcare, with reasoning capability to validate contracts, review billing and execute fixes autonomously
latest_news: Alan 产品线已在电信和医疗领域部署
latest_news_en: Alan product line deployed in telecom and healthcare sectors
source_title: Born in LatAm, built for the world: 15 AI leaders to watch in 2027

evidence.quote: Kognia is betting on what it calls cognitive AI: agents that reason through a problem instead of following a script
Kognia's site cites cuts of up to 60–95% in process time

name: Limetax
description: 专注于中小企业的AI驱动税务平台，通过收购或合作整合现有税务事务所，并用AI平台赋能它们。保留当地专业人士的客户关系和专业责任，但用AI提高效率。
description_en: AI-driven tax platform for SMEs that acquires or partners with existing tax firms and equips them with an AI platform. Retains local professional relationships and expertise while improving efficiency through AI.
why_matters: 融资模式创新：3600万欧元中3000万为收购信用额度，表明对通过整合现有事务所进行快速扩展的承诺。不同于从零开始的竞争对手，采用并购驱动增长。
why_matters_en: Novel financing structure: €30M of €36M is acquisition credit line, signaling commitment to rapid scale via consolidation of existing firms. Differs from competitor by using M&A-driven growth rather than building from scratch.
latest_news: 2026年9月宣布融资3600万欧元，其中仅600万欧元为股权融资，其余3000万欧元为收购信用额度。
latest_news_en: Announced €36M funding in September 2026, with only €6M as equity and €30M as acquisition credit line.
source_title: Fintechs 2026: Wie KI neue Geschäftsmodelle schafft

evidence.quote: Von den 36 Millionen Euro, die Limetax im September bekannt gab, entfallen nur sechs Millionen Euro auf Eigenkapital. Die übrigen 30 Millionen Euro stehen als Kreditlinie für Akquisitionen zur Verfügung.
Limetax übernimmt bestehende Kanzleien oder geht Partnerschaften mit ihnen ein. Diese bündelt das Unternehmen in einer "Agentic-First"-Gruppe für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen

name: Upfirst AI
description: Upfirst 构建 AI 接待员，为小型企业全天候接听电话、筛选潜在客户并预约，支持 35 种以上语言。其数据显示 23.9% 的来电发生在营业时间外，77% 的来电无需转接即可解决。
description_en: Upfirst builds an AI receptionist that answers calls, qualifies leads, and books appointments for small businesses around the clock, supporting over 35 languages. Its data shows 23.9% of calls come in outside business hours, and 77% of calls are resolved without transfer.
why_matters: Upfirst 用实际数据证明其产品价值：近四分之一的来电发生在营业时间外，且 77% 的来电无需人工转接即可解决，显示其在全球小型企业市场的明确应用场景和技术差异化。
why_matters_en: Upfirst demonstrates product value with real data: nearly a quarter of calls come in outside business hours, and 77% are resolved without transfer, showing clear use cases and technical differentiation for the global small-business market.
latest_news: 创始人 Alfredo Salkeld 出生于秘鲁利马，现居佛罗里达州，产品已与 Clio 等工具集成。
latest_news_en: Founder Alfredo Salkeld, born in Lima, Peru, now based in Florida; the product has integrated with tools such as Clio.
source_title: Born in LatAm, built for the world: 15 AI leaders to watch in 2027

evidence.quote: Nearly a quarter of the calls it answers, 23.9%, come in outside business hours, Salkeld has said. The AI resolves 77% of calls without transferring them, according to Sociable.

name: Coraltalk
description: Coraltalk 是一个面向大学教授和教育机构的对话式 AI 评估平台。教师向平台提供课程材料、作业和评分标准,系统会通过口头问题询问学生的作业内容,并根据学生的回答提出后续问题以探查理解程度。评估完成后,教师可以查看视频形式的对话记录、文字稿以及与评分标准对齐的反馈,最终由教师决定学生成绩。
description_en: Coraltalk is a conversational AI assessment platform for university professors and educational institutions. Instructors provide the platform with course materials, assignments, and grading criteria, which the software uses to question students about their work orally. Based on student responses, the AI asks follow-up questions to probe their understanding. After the assessment is complete, instructors can review the conversation in video form, along with transcripts and feedback aligned with their rubric, while retaining final grading authority.
why_matters: Coraltalk 让大规模个性化口试成为可能,解决了在生成式 AI 时代传统作业难以验证学生真实理解的问题。该平台已在 60 多个国家使用,包括约克大学和詹姆斯麦迪逊大学的教师,且未投入付费营销即实现增长。平台已开发 Canvas 学习管理系统集成,并获得 76.8 万加元融资,2026 年赢得纽约 EdTech Week 的 Higher Ed Shark Tank 竞赛。
why_matters_en: Coraltalk makes large-scale individualized oral examinations practical, addressing the challenge of verifying genuine student understanding in the era of generative AI when traditional assignments are insufficient. The platform has reached users in over 60 countries without paid marketing, including educators at York University and James Madison University. It has developed a Canvas learning management system integration, raised $768,000 CAD in funding, and won the Higher Ed Shark Tank competition at New York's EdTech Week in 2026.
latest_news: Coraltalk 于 2026 年 11 月宣布已获得 76.8 万加元(57 万美元)融资,并在 2026 年纽约 EdTech Week 赢得 Higher Ed Shark Tank 竞赛。公司正在推进与现有教育平台的集成战略,已开发 Canvas 学习管理系统的集成功能。
latest_news_en: In November 2026, Coraltalk announced it has raised $768,000 CAD ($570,000 USD) in funding and won the Higher Ed Shark Tank competition at New York's EdTech Week in 2026. The company is pursuing a strategy to embed its technology in third-party platforms and has developed an integration with Canvas, a widely used learning management system.

evidence.quote: The company has also raised $768,000 CAD ($570,000 USD) in funding, and this year won the Higher Ed Shark Tank competition at New York's EdTech Week.

Coraltalk is using conversational AI to bring oral examinations into the digital age. Instructors provide the platform with course materials, assignments, and grading criteria, which the software uses to question students about their work. As students respond, the AI asks follow-up questions to probe their understanding.

source_title: Coraltalk wants universities to stop chasing AI cheaters and start measuring learning

name: BluWave-ai
description: BluWave-ai 为电力公司提供人工智能软件,帮助它们将可再生能源接入电网并管理能源负载。该公司开发的应用可追踪能源负载、优化可再生能源使用和电动汽车充电。2026年夏,BluWave-ai 与安大略省四家电力公司合作,为电动汽车充电提供省级监管系统。
description_en: BluWave-ai provides AI software to utility companies to help them add renewable energy sources to their electricity grids and manage energy loads. The company has built an app that tracks energy loads, optimizes renewable energy usage and electric vehicle (EV) charging. In summer 2026, BluWave-ai partnered with four electricity utilities in Ontario to provide a provincial regulation system for EV charging.
why_matters: BluWave-ai 针对数据中心激增带来的电网压力开发了专用产品。该产品允许数据中心运营商将计算密集型工作负载转移到电网低需求时段,从而减少电力消耗。公司已建立广泛的能源管理技术专利组合,通过向客户授权专利建立业务模式。BluWave-ai 在全球设有业务,包括日本和欧洲。
why_matters_en: BluWave-ai has developed a product tailored to data centre operators that allows them to shift compute-intensive workloads to periods of low demand on electrical grids and consume less electricity in the process. The company has amassed a broad portfolio of patents for its energy management technology, allowing it to build a business out of licensing the patents to customers. BluWave-ai has established a global presence, with operations in Japan and Europe.
latest_news: 2026年11月,BluWave-ai 获得810万美元融资,其中包括天使投资者和家族办公室的股权投资、联邦政府非稀释性资金以及来自加拿大皇家银行和蒙特利尔银行的债务融资。创始人兼首席执行官 Devashish Paul 表示,融资中40%为债务工具。公司自2017年成立以来已累计融资超过2400万美元。
latest_news_en: In November 2026, BluWave-ai secured $8.1 million in a mix of equity from several angel investors and family offices, non-dilutive federal government funding, and debt from Royal Bank of Canada and Bank of Montreal. Founder and CEO Devashish Paul said the financing was 40 percent debt facilities. The company has raised more than $24 million since its founding in 2017.

evidence.quote: The Ottawa company announced on Thursday that it has secured $8.1 million in a mix of equity from several angel investors and family offices, non-dilutive federal government funding (though it did not disclose through which department), and debt from Royal Bank of Canada and Bank of Montreal.
The 40-person company is led by Paul, who was a longtime tech executive and Royal Canadian Air Force officer before founding BluWave.

source_title: BluWave-ai secures $8.1 million for energy grid software as data centres strain load
